Retire Path Financial, a respected independent firm, excels in retirement planning, insurance, investments, and wealth management. Our foundation is deep expertise and a strong commitment to our clients, designing customized financial strategies aimed at steering them towards a secure financial future in retirement.
Position Overview:The role of the Office Manager is pivotal in setting up new client accounts, guaranteeing a smooth and efficient process that aligns with our companies exemplary standards. This position requires excellent multitasking skills, outstanding customer service, and adherence to our strict quality criteria. It is essential for preserving client contentment and boosting the efficiency of our operations.
The Salary Range for this position is : $45,000 - $55,000
Primary Responsibilities:Coordinate and organize office activities.Provide exceptional customer service to new and existing clients, answering all queries about their accounts promptly and professionally.Assist in the onboarding process of new clients and ensure they are fully informed and comfortable with our services.Answer phones, email communications, scanning, copying files.Help with other projects and responsibilities as needed.
Required Qualifications:A minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a similar role within the financial services industry is strongly preferred.Exceptional customer service and communication skills.Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and financial planning software.Ability to multitask and manage time effectively.
If you want to join a dynamic and passionate team dedicated to making a difference in peoples lives, apply now!
Retire Path Financial is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity
